newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks fall on UK rate rise, Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks fall on UK rate rise, Telefonica.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended sharply lower on Wednesday, depressed by a hike in British interest rates and a sharp correction in Telefonica.
The general index fell 3.14 points, 0.83 percent, to 375.89 and the Ibex-35 lost 43.41 points, 1.0 percent, to 4,308.77.
Telefonica fell 70 pesetas, 2.64 percent, to 2,580 in heavy trade as dealers took profits after an 8.83 percent in the last 12 sessions.
The stock was also dulled by Tuesday's Goldman Sach's downgrade on the stock, due to its high price.
Repsol fell 75 pesetas to 4,155 with volume of 2.3 million shares, boosted by block trades including one by Renta 4 for 603,264 shares. Repsol has lost 7.46 percent in eight sessions.
Banks were also lower, particulary Popular and Argentaria. The latter announced a 13.1 percent fall in net profit to September after the market closed.
Turnover today was high at around 63.7 billion pesetas.
